# P1: whole global pass. J and K are fixed 40 mm apart; five capacitors hang from U, which is
# fixed, so the solve stacks them and the legaliser must spread them.
board 0 0 60 40
cell J 0 20 1 2 fixed
cell K 40 20 1 2 fixed
cell U 20 20 3 3 fixed
cell C1 5 5 1 0.5 free
cell C2 35 35 1 0.5 free
cell C3 10 30 1 0.5 free
cell C4 30 8 1 0.5 free
cell C5 25 25 1 0.5 free
net a 1 J C1 C3
net b 1 K C2 C4
net c 1 U C1 C2 C3 C4 C5
net g 0.1 J K U C1 C2 C3 C4 C5
expect hpwl_before 202
expect hpwl_after 91.00003824563832
expect iterations 4

expect C2 25.511816996382993 20.000006499218294
expect C3 14.488187245627746 21.00000393916528
expect C4 25.511815219733887 18.999996905313072
